symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of consecutive address bits in each chunk, one chunk per transform axis.
symbols.quote: The layer acts on $D$ [transform axes](transform-axis.md), each a chunk of $\delta$ consecutive address bits, where $\delta$ is the number of bits in each chunk.

symbols.name: selected offset
symbols.meaning: The position of the selected bit within its chunk, counted from the least significant end, with $0\le o<\delta$.
symbols.quote: In each chunk one bit is selected, at offset $o$ with $0\le o<\delta$, where $o$ is the position of the selected bit within its chunk, counted from the least significant end.

symbols.name: normalized Hadamard matrix
symbols.quote: The unitary normalization $1/\sqrt q$ would instead give the normalized Hadamard matrix $\mathcal{H}=\frac1{\sqrt2}\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}=\sqrt2\,H_0$.

symbols.name: diagonal phase matrix
symbols.meaning: The diagonal $2\times2$ matrix $\mathrm{diag}(1,i)$ that multiplies one basis entry by $i$.

symbols.name: bit-flip matrix
symbols.meaning: The $2\times2$ matrix swapping the two coordinates of a bit.

symbols.name: two-point kernel
symbols.meaning: The $2\times2$ matrix $\mathcal{H}\Delta\mathcal{H}=\lambda I+\mu X$ acting on one selected bit.

symbols.name: identity coefficient
symbols.meaning: The complex coefficient $(1+i)/2$ of the identity $I$ in $C$.
symbols.quote: Let $\lambda=(1+i)/2$ and $\mu=(1-i)/2$, where $\lambda$ is the coefficient of the identity $I$ and $\mu$ the coefficient of $X$.

symbols.name: bit-flip coefficient
symbols.meaning: The complex coefficient $(1-i)/2$ of the bit flip $X$ in $C$.
symbols.quote: Let $\lambda=(1+i)/2$ and $\mu=(1-i)/2$, where $\lambda$ is the coefficient of the identity $I$ and $\mu$ the coefficient of $X$.

symbols.name: phase operator
symbols.meaning: The diagonal operator on $D$ selected bits that multiplies each address by $i$ raised to the number of selected bits equal to 1 there.
symbols.quote: Direct multiplication gives $H_0=\mu\,\Delta C\,\Delta$, hence $H_0^{\otimes D}=\mu^D\,\Delta_D\,C^{\otimes D}\,\Delta_D$, where $\Delta_D$ multiplies the value at each address by $i$ raised to the number of selected bits equal to 1 there.

relations.quote: A simultaneous butterfly layer applies the two-point map of a [butterfly](butterfly.md) to one selected bit of each of $D$ [transform axes](transform-axis.md) at once
The layer acts on $D$ [transform axes](transform-axis.md), each a chunk of $\delta$ consecutive address bits, where $\delta$ is the number of bits in each chunk.
With $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$, the layer is the [tensor power](tensor-product.md) of $H_0$ on the selected bits, written $H_0^{\otimes D}$.
The layer applies the length-two case of the [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) to each selected bit.
The layer is built from the [two-point kernel](two-point-kernel.md) $C$ on each selected bit.
The layer expresses its phase frames through the [complex phase network](complex-phase-network.md), as products of $C$ on the selected bits.

relations.predicate: splits selected bits into groups by
relations.quote: The layer splits selected bits into groups by [binary changes of basis](binary-change-of-basis.md), which are invertible row additions over the binary field that relabel the bits.
The layer moves its address chunks by [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), a tape procedure
The procedure ends with one final [truncation](truncation.md) of its values.
